system.effect:
Effect: You may grow additional Berries and Herbs, depending on the higher of your General Education or Survival Rank.
» Novice: You may grow @CompSearch[Items keywords="Tier 2"]{Tier 2 Berries}.
» Adept: You may grow @UUID[Compendium.ptu.items.Item.cV0b4kZaHh5OuGC8]{Mental Herbs}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.items.Item.5IJIFPkP9KOMGQvx]{Power Herbs}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.items.Item.nk3lnYxEsX1KqeAU]{White Herbs}, and @UUID[Compendium.ptu.items.Item.w5F8OjCc7rGRSlXz]{Tiny Mushrooms}.
» Expert: You may grow @UUID[Compendium.ptu.items.Item.Qr4cNnGJVou1A9yQ]{Revival Herbs}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.items.Item.7rq6umzCl1cTm5ny]{Energy Roots}, @UUID[Compendium.ptu.items.Item.qjXGxkVxalQcIpuD]{Big Mushrooms}, and @CompSearch[Items keywords="Tier 3"]{Tier 3 Berries}.
» Master: Increase the Soil Quality of all your plants by +1.
system.name: Top Tier Berries [CR]
